scope: single-merchant knowledge answers and durable human takeover
requirements: Only currently authorized reviewed published external knowledge supports ANSWER
Citation IDs and labels match the actual supplied context and persisted result
No raw generation delta, internal evidence or object storage path reaches customers
Clarify missing question context at most once, then hand off if still insufficient
Missing knowledge, conflicting evidence, provider failure and customer request create a queue entry
Dynamic order, inventory, current price and delivery commitments are outside this milestone
Only one staff member can claim and reply under a live lease and matching conversation epoch
Queued and human conversations do not trigger autonomous AI replies
Human replies have human provenance and are not automatically ingested as knowledge
Reconnect and restart preserve authorized messages without duplicate delivery
Revocation and unpublished sources filter both historical messages and event replay
input_policy: Freeze queries, source hashes and semantic expectations before generating an evaluated batch; retain all historical baseline inputs and reports
review_policy: Review actual captured answers and delivered evidence; JSON validity, lexical overlap and absence of hallucination alone do not establish a pass
